answer: Guarantor admission gates entry. An applicant locks 40 POA in the vault; a guarantor co-signs with 60 POA. Pairs are drawn on the public atlas, so one guarantor backing fifty strangers forms a star cluster. Reputation decays 5% per epoch without honest work; an umber mark stains identities whose guarantor backed fakes. 100 fakes lock 10,000 POA yet each earns at most 15 POA, a certain loss. Honest agents pay once and earn without dilution.
